title: FORMAT with a BLANK format string and the locale "en-GB" is the general date, day first and 24-hour

source.quote: Where day precedes month and time is 24-hour format.
source.supports: the example = FORMAT( dt"2020-12-15T12:30:59", BLANK(), "en-GB" ) returns 15/12/2020 12:30:59

source.quote: If format_string is BLANK, the value is formatted with a "General Number" or "General Date" format (according to value data type).
